points.title: 贵族童年
points.description: 弗朗西斯·培根1561年1月22日出生于伦敦一个显赫的贵族家庭，父亲尼古拉·培根是伊丽莎白一世时期的掌玺大臣，母亲安·库克是著名人文主义者安东尼·库克的女儿。培根在家中接受了良好的教育，从小展现出非凡的智力。这段贵族家庭背景为他后来的政治生涯奠定了基础，同时也使他深刻理解权力运作的机制。培根的童年时期正值英国宗教改革和文艺复兴的交汇点，这对他后来的思想发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Francis Bacon was born on January 22, 1561, in London to a prominent noble family. His father, Nicholas Bacon, was Lord Keeper of the Great Seal under Queen Elizabeth I, and his mother, Anne Cooke, was the daughter of the renowned humanist Anthony Cooke. Bacon received an excellent education at home, displaying exceptional intellectual abilities from a young age. This aristocratic background laid the foundation for his later political career and gave him deep insights into the mechanisms of power. His childhood coincided with the intersection of the English Reformation and the Renaissance, which profoundly influenced his later intellectual development.

points.title: 早期教育
points.description: 培根12岁时进入剑桥大学三一学院学习，但仅在校两年便离开。他对当时盛行的经院哲学感到失望，认为其过于依赖亚里士多德的权威而缺乏创新。这段经历促使他开始思考知识体系的革新。离开剑桥后，他跟随英国驻法大使前往巴黎，在那里接触到欧洲大陆的政治和思想环境，开阔了国际视野。这段早期教育经历塑造了培根对传统学术的批判态度，为他后来提出新科学方法论奠定了思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: At the age of 12, Bacon entered Trinity College, Cambridge, where he studied for only two years before leaving. He became disillusioned with the prevailing scholastic philosophy, which he criticized for relying too heavily on Aristotle's authority without innovation. This experience prompted him to begin contemplating the reform of knowledge systems. After leaving Cambridge, he accompanied the English ambassador to France, where he was exposed to European political and intellectual environments, broadening his international perspective. This early educational experience shaped Bacon's critical attitude toward traditional academia and laid the philosophical foundation for his later advocacy of a new scientific method.

points.title: 政治生涯
points.description: 培根于1584年进入议会开始政治生涯，凭借其家族背景和卓越才能逐渐上升。他先后担任过下议院议员、检察长、掌玺大臣等重要职务。1617年，他被任命为掌玺大臣，次年晋升为大法官，达到政治生涯的顶峰。然而，1621年，他被指控接受贿赂，虽经审判后被免职，但这一事件结束了他的政治生涯。在政治舞台上，培根展现了卓越的行政才能和法律知识，同时也因道德争议而备受批评。这段政治经历使他深刻认识到权力与道德之间的复杂关系，也促使他将更多精力转向哲学和科学研究。
points.descriptionEn: Bacon entered Parliament in 1584, beginning his political career. Through his family connections and exceptional abilities, he gradually rose through the ranks, serving as a Member of Parliament, Attorney General, and Lord Keeper of the Great Seal. In 1617, he was appointed Lord Keeper of the Great Seal and promoted to Lord Chancellor in 1618, reaching the pinnacle of his political career. However, in 1621, he was accused of accepting bribes. Although acquitted after trial, he was dismissed from office, effectively ending his political career. On the political stage, Bacon demonstrated outstanding administrative abilities and legal knowledge but was also criticized for moral controversies. This political experience gave him profound insights into the complex relationship between power and morality, leading him to focus more on philosophy and scientific research.

points.title: 哲学创作
points.description: 尽管政治生涯占据培根大部分时间，但他从未放弃哲学思考。1597年，他出版了《散文集》，展现其文学才华。1605年，发表《学术的进展》，提出知识改革计划。1620年，出版《新工具》，系统阐述其归纳法哲学，被誉为现代科学方法的奠基之作。培根的哲学思想强调经验主义和归纳法，反对经院哲学的演绎法。他主张通过观察和实验获取知识，提出'知识就是力量'的著名观点。在高哈姆庄园，培根潜心写作，完成了多部重要著作，对后世科学革命产生了深远影响，被视为现代科学方法的奠基人之一。
points.descriptionEn: Despite his political career occupying most of his time, Bacon never abandoned philosophical pursuits. In 1597, he published his 'Essays,' showcasing his literary talent. In 1605, he published 'The Advancement of Learning,' proposing a plan for the reform of knowledge. In 1620, he published 'Novum Organum,' systematically expounding his philosophy of induction, regarded as a foundational work of modern scientific method. Bacon's philosophical thought emphasized empiricism and induction, opposing the scholastic method of deduction. He advocated acquiring knowledge through observation and experimentation, proposing the famous concept that 'knowledge is power.' At Gorhambury Estate, Bacon devoted himself to writing, completing several important works that profoundly influenced the later Scientific Revolution, establishing him as one of the founders of modern scientific methodology.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1626年3月，培根在实验过程中受寒感染肺炎，于4月9日在伦敦逝世，享年65岁。临终前，他仍在进行关于肉类防腐的实验。培根的去世标志着英国文艺复兴时期一位重要思想家的离去。他的哲学思想，尤其是强调经验主义和归纳法的方法论，对后世科学革命产生了深远影响。牛顿、洛克等后来的思想家都深受其影响。培根被视为现代科学方法的奠基人，'知识就是力量'的理念至今仍广为流传。他的著作被翻译成多种语言，影响遍及全球。培根的思想遗产不仅体现在科学领域，还体现在政治、法律和文学等多个方面，成为西方思想史上的重要人物。
points.descriptionEn: In March 1626, Bacon contracted pneumonia after being exposed to cold while conducting an experiment on the preservation of meat. He died in London on April 9, 1626, at the age of 65. At the time of his death, he was still engaged in experiments about meat preservation. Bacon's death marked the departure of an important thinker of the English Renaissance. His philosophical thought, particularly his methodology emphasizing empiricism and induction, had a profound impact on the later Scientific Revolution. Later thinkers such as Newton and Locke were deeply influenced by his ideas. Bacon is regarded as the founder of modern scientific method, and his concept that 'knowledge is power' remains widely quoted today. His works have been translated into multiple languages and have had global influence. Bacon's intellectual legacy extends not only to science but also to politics, law, and literature, making him a significant figure in the history of Western thought.

supporter.zh: 培根被誉为现代科学方法的奠基人，他的经验主义和归纳法思想彻底改变了人类获取知识的方式。他提出的'知识就是力量'理念激励了无数科学家探索自然规律。培根的哲学体系为科学革命奠定了理论基础，使人类从依赖权威和演绎的传统思维转向基于观察和实验的实证研究。他的《新工具》被视为科学方法论的经典著作，对后世科学发展产生了不可估量的影响。作为文艺复兴时期的杰出思想家，培根代表了人类理性精神的觉醒，他的思想遗产至今仍在推动科学进步和社会发展。
supporter.en: Bacon is celebrated as the founder of modern scientific method, and his empiricist and inductive thinking revolutionized the way humanity acquires knowledge. His concept that 'knowledge is power' has inspired countless scientists to explore the laws of nature. Bacon's philosophical system laid the theoretical foundation for the Scientific Revolution, shifting human thought from reliance on authority and deduction to empirical research based on observation and experimentation. His 'Novum Organum' is regarded as a classic work on scientific methodology, having an immeasurable impact on the development of modern science. As an outstanding thinker of the Renaissance, Bacon represented the awakening of human rational spirit, and his intellectual legacy continues to drive scientific progress and social development today.

critic.zh: 批评者指出培根的科学方法论存在局限性，他过分强调归纳法而忽视了演绎法的重要性。此外，培根本人的政治生涯因受贿指控而蒙上污点，这与其倡导的道德理想形成鲜明对比。一些哲学家认为培根的思想过于功利主义，将知识简化为控制自然和获取权力的工具。批评者还指出，培根对科学方法的描述过于理想化，忽视了科学研究中的直觉、想象和创造性思维的重要性。尽管如此，培根的思想仍对科学发展产生了深远影响，但其理论体系也存在明显的时代局限性。
critic.en: Critics point out that Bacon's scientific methodology has limitations, as he overemphasized induction while neglecting the importance of deduction. Furthermore, Bacon's own political career was tainted by bribery allegations, creating a stark contrast with the moral ideals he advocated. Some philosophers argue that Bacon's thought is excessively utilitarian, reducing knowledge to a tool for controlling nature and acquiring power. Critics also note that Bacon's description of the scientific method was overly idealized, neglecting the importance of intuition, imagination, and creative thinking in scientific research. Despite this, Bacon's ideas had a profound impact on the development of science, but his theoretical system also has clear limitations of his time.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，培根被视为连接中世纪与现代科学的关键人物。他的思想既保留了文艺复兴时期的人文主义精神，又为后来的科学革命提供了方法论基础。培根的著作在科学史上具有里程碑意义，他首次系统阐述了经验主义科学方法的重要性。在流行文化中，培根常被描绘为理性与进步的象征，'知识就是力量'的名言成为启蒙运动的标志性口号。然而，历史学家也认识到培根思想的复杂性，他既是一位科学方法的倡导者，也是一位政治家，其思想体系反映了当时社会的矛盾与转型。培根的形象在历史长河中不断被重新诠释，但其作为现代科学先驱的地位始终得到广泛认可。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Bacon is regarded as a pivotal figure connecting the medieval and modern scientific worlds. His thought preserved the humanist spirit of the Renaissance while providing methodological foundations for the later Scientific Revolution. Bacon's works are milestones in the history of science, as he was the first to systematically articulate the importance of empirical scientific methods. In popular culture, Bacon is often depicted as a symbol of reason and progress, and his famous quote 'knowledge is power' has become an iconic slogan of the Enlightenment. However, historians also recognize the complexity of Bacon's thought; he was both an advocate of scientific method and a politician, and his intellectual system reflected the contradictions and transformations of his time. Bacon's image has been continuously reinterpreted throughout history, but his status as a pioneer of modern science remains widely acknowledged.

others.zh: 培根是科学的哥伦布，他发现了新大陆，不是地理上的，而是思想上的。
others.en: Bacon is the Columbus of science; he discovered a new world, not in geography, but in thought.
